top_signals.title: Once-AAA Bonds on New York Megamall Face Over $350 Million Loss
top_signals.summary: Pyramid Management Group, a shopping center developer, is buying back the mortgage on a struggling megamall it owns in Syracuse, New York, for cents on the dollar, mostly wiping out bonds that originally carried top ratings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: The 72-hour crisis that could upend Meta’s business in India as firm risks losing legal protection
top_signals.summary: U.S. social media giant Meta is facing increasing pressure from Indian regulators, including demands to revoke the firm's safe harbor immunity in the country.
